channel.title: Cadenza Arthouse Press
channel.description: Independent media, photography, and documentary coverage of arts, culture, and community in Houston and beyond.

item.title: No Shade Fashion Show Packs Sanman Studios for a Night of Derby-Themed Glamour
item.description: The Art Districtt's sold-out No Shade Fashion Show brought a Derby-themed runway, a lineup of Houston designers and a live Be Someone art reveal to Sanman Studios in a celebration of creativity without comparison.

item.title: Houston Organizers Canvass East End Businesses Following ICE Shooting
item.description: Following the fatal shooting of Lorenzo Salgado Araujo by an ICE officer, volunteers with Houston DSA and OPN canvass East End businesses with immigrant rights information as community pressure shifts toward local leadership.

item.title: 713 Day: Cafecito, Comunidad y Cultura in Houston
item.description: Cadenza Arthouse documents United We Dream Texas' 713 Day celebration in Houston — Aztec dance, music, and community organizers uplifting immigrant voices.

item.title: A River of Diverse Works Ignites MATCH Gallery
item.description: DiverseWorks' "River on Fire" brought together 14 Houston-based artists confronting environmental crisis and climate change at MATCH Gallery, curated by Ashley DeHoyos Sauder.

item.title: Houston's Third Ward Marks Black August with Community Fitness and Training
item.description: Houston's Third Ward community gathers at Peggy Park to observe Black August — a day of fitness training, disaster preparedness, and political education organized by ANPU and the Huey P. Newton Gun Club.

item.title: Echoes of Unity at the Pan-African Connection - Dallas
item.description: I came for the poetry and accidentally found an entire Black-owned marketplace, incredible food, elders dropping wisdom, poets dropping truth, and enough unexpected moments to blow my mind clean out of my head. Welcome to the Pan-African Connection—one of Dallas' hidden cultural treasures.

item.title: Womankind 2024 by Cultured Concepts
item.description: A motorcycle parade, world champion martial artists, yoga queens, artists, healers, entrepreneurs, and one visionary organizer. Step inside Womankind 2024 and experience a powerful celebration of feminine energy, community, creativity, and empowerment in the heart of Houston.

item.title: Culture Sessions in Houston
item.description: Aisha Shahid and ANPU host the Afrolatino Culture Sessions — a Houston gathering celebrating unity, shared heritage, and the strength of the Afro-Latino community.

item.title: Chelita Lenice Fashion Show
item.description: A brief photo journal check-in at the fashion show. Our photographer picks up an appreciation for the city and leaves something to come back for.

item.title: For the Love of Art
item.description: Independent Houston artists gather for presentations and media moments in Sugarland, TX
